notes.title: How to Enhance Player Engagement and Immersion Through Control Design?
notes.notes:
In our current naval warfare game, we aim to improve gameplay and competitiveness by refining player control mechanics.
Inspired by iconic World War II movies, the game adopts a roguelike survival mode where players can either control a warship to defend against waves of AI-controlled fighter planes or take command of a squadron of fighter planes to attack an enemy fleet.

For now, let’s focus on the first mode: how can we design controls to ensure players feel both exhilarated and deeply engaged while commanding their fleet against relentless aerial assaults?
Similarly, if players are piloting a squadron of fighter planes to attack warships, how can we craft the controls to deliver a cinematic sense of immersion?

We invite everyone to share their ideas and feedback to help us continually refine the gameplay, making it more enjoyable and tailored to player expectations. Let’s create a game that players will truly love!

notes.title: Naval Battle Game Demo Release Announcement
notes.notes:
[b]Introduction[/b]
After a dedicated period of development, the first demo of our naval battle game is finally here! This release showcases the core gameplay mechanics and fundamental features of the game. We look forward to gathering valuable feedback and suggestions from players to improve and refine future versions. Our ultimate goal is to create a game that players love and enjoy.

[b]Key Features[/b]
1. Basic UI and Level Experience
The demo introduces key aspects of gameplay, including ship controls, camera perspective adjustments during battles, and an immersive level experience.

2. Enhanced Input Controls

[list]
[*] Revised Ship Controls:
[list]
[*] W Key: Increases the ship’s speed by one gear each time it is pressed. The ship gradually accelerates to the set speed.
[*] S Key: Decreases the speed by one gear with each press, eventually stopping or moving into reverse.
[*] Players no longer need to hold down keys continuously for speed adjustment, making the experience smoother.
[/list]
[*] Turning Mechanics:
[list]
[*] A/D Keys: Steer the ship left or right. Releasing the keys allows the ship to auto-correct and resume straight navigation.
[*] This system ensures intuitive and user-friendly controls.
[/list][/list]

3. Perspective and Aiming System

[list]
[*] Use the mouse to pan the camera horizontally, with the main cannon always targeting the center of the screen.
[*] The mouse wheel lets players switch between various views, including close-range, long-range, top-down, zoomed-in, and anti-aircraft (the anti-aircraft view is designed for future updates involving aircraft carriers).
[/list]

4. Combat Repairs and Emergency Response

[list]
[*] Damage and Repair System:
[list]
[*] If the engine is damaged, the ship will lose mobility and gradually stop. Players must repair it promptly using hotkeys to resume navigation.
[*] If the cannons are hit, they may become inoperable, and crew members could suffer casualties, reducing combat efficiency. Players must conduct firefighting, rescue operations, and repairs to mitigate further damage.
[/list][*] These mechanics add depth, interactivity, and strategy to the gameplay.
[/list]

5. Comprehensive Menu System

[list]
[*] The demo includes customizable settings for graphics, key bindings, and language options.
[*] Languages currently supported include English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese, with more languages planned for future updates.
[/list]

[b]Community and Social Platforms[/b]
To better connect with players, we’ve launched several social media platforms. Join us to share your thoughts and experiences:

Discord
Tiktok
Patreon

We look forward to hearing from you and making this game even better together!

notes.title: Thank You for Your Support and Attention – New Demo Version Coming Soon
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368439/766a70e6f5c432c46f7596d8c1e573eb66cab460.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44368439/68acb6857889292a72aafe81672f76a21e60718e.jpg[/img][/url]
Dear Players,

First and foremost, we would like to extend our sincere gratitude for your continuous support and attention! Thanks to your enthusiastic feedback and anticipation, our team is working hard to finalize the new version of the game. We are excited to announce that the new demo is currently in testing and will be available to you very soon—please stay tuned!

In this new version, we've made several key improvements and optimizations. One of the most significant changes is the revamped controls for the battleships. The new system is designed to be more intuitive, aligning the controls with those of a typical vehicle rather than character-based movement. This means players will experience smoother, more natural handling, and no longer feel overwhelmed by complex controls.

Additionally, we've introduced a new feature that allows for more detailed damage detection across various parts of the ship. Now, players can clearly see which sections of their battleship are taking damage, enabling them to make more strategic decisions during combat.

To further enhance the immersive experience, we’ve also incorporated some new voice effects to intensify the atmosphere during battles. These audio cues will help bring the combat scenarios to life, making the action feel even more thrilling and engaging.

Once again, we sincerely thank you for your continued support and patience. We will continue to work hard to improve and refine the game, aiming to deliver the best possible experience to you. Please stay tuned for the upcoming release of the new version!

Thank you once again!

Shawn

November 16, 2024

notes.title: Naval Battle Game (INB) release date to be delayed
notes.notes:
Due to various reasons, the final release date of the Naval Battle Game (INB) will be postponed.
During the development process of this project, we absorbed more creative ideas, new ways of playing, and made continuous attempts to replace the new game engine. Based on the above factors, the release of the final version will be postponed.
In the future development process, we will release demos periodically to provide players with the experience of new versions and new gameplay. We will also enhance communication with players and absorb your valuable opinions and suggestions to continuously improve the game.
We believe that the naval battle game will become your favorite product, and we would like to thank everyone for your understanding and support.

notes.title: The demo version of the game "Iron Naval Battle" has been released!
notes.notes:
Hello friends. After days and nights of production, the demo version of the game "Iron Naval Battle" finally meets with you today.
The demo version includes four battleships and a supply ship.
The four battleships include Yukikaze-class destroyers, Fletcher-class destroyers, Akenthal-class battleships, and Yamato-class battleships. The current version only includes one scene, five basic levels and one skirmish level.
The Demo version also includes the basic functions and game modes of the official version. We are also accumulating and updating gamers to make the game easier to use. At the same time, we also hope to hear your valuable suggestions and opinions, and we will work together to improve this game.
